verdict.rationale: The docs show enterprise SSO for any SAML or OIDC IdP, organizations and SSO connections managed as related objects (including Auth0 imports of organizations and enterprise SSO connections), self-serve IT admin onboarding, and IdP role assignment via SSO. Community users confirm the SAML setup wizard works well, so per-organization SSO connections are reasonably evidenced. Nothing in the pack documents domain verification or just-in-time user provisioning on SSO login; Directory Sync is SCIM-based provisioning, a different mechanism. Missing for 10: verified domain ownership per organization, JIT provisioning on first SSO login, explicit docs tying one SSO connection to each organization.
